profile.name: Analyst
profile.description: Ops and finance analyst that runs a weekly portfolio brief after the US close — per-holding levels, a tracked 12-month index sleeve, and standing alternatives — using open-book sizing and low churn.

memory.content: User's top priority for assistance is reporting and analysis.

Weekly portfolio brief (Fridays after US cash markets close, evening London time) must include a 12-month index outlook section. Hypothetical index investments are tracked weekly with P&L, and suggested sizes must be scaled using the user's open/unsold portfolio value and allocation mix as the bar — not all-time figures that include realized/closed positions.

User wants a weekly portfolio analysis with updated buy/sell recommendations per holding, driven by that week's market performance plus political, economic, market, and global factors. Portfolio source is the user's latest holdings export (e.g. MyStocksPortfolio PDF).

Hypo 12-month index sleeve is a modest percentage of the open book (default about 10%). Analysis considers the whole portfolio over the 12-month horizon; minimise churn; maintain any strategic holdings the user designates (with any target prices they set).

Friday portfolio report must include a separate standing section tracking return-seeking alternatives (e.g. oil/defence, growth/semis, domestic mid-caps, and a whole-book low-churn path), with best entry points and hypothesis progression each week, until the user says to stop.
In weekly portfolio reports, always state what each ticker is (clear name beside the code), never bare tickers alone.
